text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (March 17, 2026) for 144 Wallace Avenue

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed Items 1, 6 through to 10 and 21 of the Property Standards Order (March 17, 2026), for 144 Wallace Avenue, Folder No. 26 127567 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 30, 2026. 2. Confirmed Items 2, 5, 11, 13 and 14 of the Property Standards Order (March 17, 2026), for 144 Wallace Avenue, Folder No. 26 127567 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 31, 2026. 3. Confirmed Items 3, 4, 12, 15 through to 20, and 22 through to 25 of the Property Standards Order (March 17, 2026), for 144 Wallace Avenue, Folder No. 26 127567 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to November 30, 2026.
